correctness.rationale: Exact support decomposition: zero outside support needs >=1 positive neighbor; if exactly one, that selected neighbor is forced label2; otherwise free labels 1/2. Exhausting all 65,536 supports per graph gives the entire integer-coefficient polynomial. A direct independent C++ traversal of each of 3^16 labelings agrees on all coefficients. The lower bound 16<=p+3w<=4w proves w>=4; equality forces 4 independent labels1. Four rook transversals per choice of permutation give 24; the nine Shrikhande nonneighbors of origin contain exactly four independent triples, whose translated subgroup cosets give 16. The (16,6,2,2) double count gives exactly two selected neighbors at each outsider. Finite scope exact, no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: An exact all-weight labelled Italian-domination polynomial comparison between canonical cospectral strongly regular twins is a natural nontrivial invariant, sharpening the prior minimum-only rook theorem and a previously known equality of total-domination polynomials. The eight low-degree differences, precise cancellation from degree 12 onward, and geometry of 16 versus 24 optimal functions provide a concrete coefficient-level benchmark and a distinct subgroup-coset explanation. The result is not claimed to generalize to all strongly regular graphs.
